content: {"summary":"The evidence does not record which specific cause is driving the current high CPU; it provides a systematic way to distinguish GC thrashing, retry‑spin, and month‑end serialization based on thread dumps, GC metrics, and log patterns.","likely_cause":"Not recorded in the evidence","confidence":"low","claims":[{"text":"Identify the busiest JVM threads with top -H and capture their IDs for dump analysis.","evidence_ids":["RB-001#4"],"quote":"Note the thread IDs (the `PID` column in thread mode) with the highest CPU."},{"text":"GC thrashing shows GC thread names and old‑gen usage >95% with rising full‑GC counts.","evidence_ids":["RB-001#5","RB-001#7"],"quote":"Threads named `GC Thread#N` or `G1 Conc#N` at the top"},{"text":"Retry spin appears as ledger‑retry‑* threads in the dump and LEDGER‑E455 errors in the logs.","evidence_ids":["RB-001#5","RB-009#4"],"quote":"Several `ledger-retry-*` threads inside the retry queue's poll loop"},{"text":"Oversized month‑end batch serialization shows a single http‑nio thread deep in Jackson serializer frames and coincides with the batch start time.","evidence_ids":["RB-001#5","RB-013#2"],"quote":"One `http-nio-*` thread deep in Jackson serializer frames"},{"text":"Check GC health with jstat; old‑gen >95% and increasing FGC indicate thrashing.","evidence_ids":["RB-001#7"],"quote":"Read the `O` column (old generation, % used) and `FGC`/`FGCT`"}],"next_checks":["Run `kubectl top -H` on the affected pod to list top‑CPU threads and note their native IDs.","Convert the native IDs to hex and retrieve two thread dumps ten seconds apart.","Search the dumps for `GC Thread` names – if present, suspect GC thrashing.","Search for `ledger-retry-` thread names and correlate with `LEDGER-E455` log entries – if present, suspect retry spin.","Search for `http-nio-` threads inside Jackson serializer frames – if present on only one pod, suspect month‑end serialization.","Execute `jstat -gcutil` on the pod and verify old‑gen % and FGC trend.","Review Kafka broker health and logs for ENOSPC or outage that could trigger retries."]}
